title: Sector-specific CII categorization overlay for the defence industry

lifecycle.note: The act states no special commencement rule; the date follows first official publication on 2026-06-29 and the general seven-day rule.

governance_rules.rule: Applies to IS, telecommunication networks and industrial control systems functioning in the defence industry.
Defines sector-specific establishment and calculation of significance indicators for assigning a CII category.
The CII-subject head creates a permanent categorization commission under PP 127 clauses 11-13.
Identify objects to be categorized and processes whose disruption or termination may disrupt or terminate those objects.

indicator_and_dependency_rules.rule: When one CII object depends on another, including another subject's object, assign the highest category resulting from its own categorization or the depended-on object's categorization.

calculation_rules.territory_rule: Use Russian-region and municipality boundaries for 2(a); use number of residents for 2(b).

calculation_rules.rule: Assess contracts and whether the object supports performance of functions of a public body or organization created by federal law.
Assess contracts and the object's role in negotiations or signing a planned Russian international treaty, by treaty level.

zero_rules: A = 0 when object failure causes no compensable harm
X = 0 when no recorded prior incident data exist

calculation_rules.rule: Compare U8 with PP 127 position 8 thresholds and conclude category or no-category necessity.

budget_window.text_conflict_guard: Clause text describes both preceding and planned periods; preserve the text and do not silently normalize the direction.

calculation_rules.source_wording_guard: The source describes D_i as forecast income while also calling D a preceding-period average; preserve this drafting tension.

calculation_rules.rule: Compare U9 with PP 127 position 9 thresholds and conclude category or no-category necessity.

calculation_rules.territory_rule: Use region or municipality boundaries for 11(a); use residents on affected territories for 11(b).

calculation_rules.rule: Assess contracts and whether the object supports normal or reserve operation and performance of a command post or situation centre, by its level.
Do not continue the clause 34 calculation.

calculation_rules.stop_rule: If the incident completely stops SDO production and no alternative method can replace the object's work, do not calculate the clause 37 and 38 values.

calculation_rules.rule: Assess contracts and assign based on the subject's status in the head contractor's state-defence-order cooperation chain.

guardrails: The overlay is in force from 2026-07-07; this date is derived, not expressly stated in the resolution.
Clause 6 creates a document route after category assignment but states no number of days or hours.
Clause 8 requires the highest category when a dependency is found; it is not a permission to downgrade either object.
Clause 9 intervals are maximum elapsed review intervals, not evidence-retention periods.
Positions 3, 4 and 10-10^7 delegate calculation to transport, communications and financial-sector overlays respectively; do not invent local formulas.
Clause 23 compensation constants must not be generalized outside this indicator calculation.
Preserve the clause 24-28 preceding/planned and actual/forecast drafting tensions; do not silently rewrite the act.
Clause 35 is a nonpositive-calculation stop condition, not an automatic no-category decision for the whole object.
The three-year values in clauses 27, 28, 36 and 38 are calculation lookbacks, not retention requirements.
The clause 39 full-stop/no-alternative condition suppresses the specified calculations; it does not prove absence of significance.
No category is proven until applicable PP 127 thresholds and all relevant sector dependencies are evaluated.
